mapper.select: select f.favorite_id, f.visitor_uid, f.plant_id, p.plant_name, p.cover_image, p.plant_summary, p.difficulty_level, p.price_level, f.status, f.create_time, f.cancel_time from zx_favorite_record f left join zx_plant p on f.plant_id = p.plant_id where f.status = '0' and f.visitor_uid = #{visitorUid} order by f.create_time desc, f.favorite_id desc

select favorite_id, visitor_uid, plant_id, status, create_time, cancel_time from zx_favorite_record where visitor_uid = #{visitorUid} and plant_id = #{plantId} and status = '0' order by favorite_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into zx_favorite_record (visitor_uid, plant_id, status, create_time) values (#{visitorUid}, #{plantId}, #{status}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update zx_favorite_record set status = '1', cancel_time = sysdate() where visitor_uid = #{visitorUid} and plant_id = #{plantId} and status = '0'
